content.short: Lyra is a decentralized options protocol that enables users to buy and sell options.
content.description: Lyra is a decentralized options protocol designed to compete with traditional centralized exchanges by delivering on-chain options trading with high liquidity and transparent pricing. It runs across Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Solana, and supports active trading through features like instant buying and selling of calls and puts. Traders benefit from pricing that stays competitive with other venues and from robust liquidity that mitigates risk for liquidity providers.
